correctness.rationale: Over algebraically closed k of characteristic 3, ∂e4/∂x_i=e3−x_i e2+x_i² e1−x_i³ makes every critical coordinate a root of a common cubic, hence at most three distinct values. Coefficient comparison with three distinct roots forces all multiplicities ≡1 (mod 3), so for sum 9 the only patterns are (1,1,7) and (1,4,4), giving coordinate or singleton/4+4 balanced line families. The eight two-value derivative cases and constant vectors add no others. Independently generated exactly 36 coordinate plus 315 balanced distinct projective lines, checked identically vanishing cubic gradient coefficients on every line, and exhausted all 9841 P^8(F3) points: exactly 522 singular points equal the predicted line-point union. Finite F3 check corroborates, not proves completeness over alg closure; the exhaustive cubic-root/multiplicity argument does. Singular support pure dimension one implies squarefree irreducibility and Serre normality; degree 351 by reduced pure 1-dimensional component sum.
